items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: We played the whole edition there, Leslie's Blackbirds.

ctx.x: Yeah. But they were just the opposite. So -- well, see, bands have commitments. (Unintelligible) the services aren't needed. We played our commitment there. Then Alley got the call for another edition of Blue Leslie's Blackbirds, downtown.

Well, we had the men that could play it. And they were all experienced showmen, had experience playing shows. Alley took the same band down there, and we played that whole time, for the show. We played the whole edition there, Leslie's Blackbirds. The last one they had, that was in 1928.
